meaning.vi: Trình bày phân từ của alkalize.

sentences.en: Start each day with an alkalizing cup of lemon water by squeezing a fresh lemon (not sugar) into purified water. Make sure you embody the pulp.
sentences.vi: Bắt đầu mỗi ngày với một cốc nước chanh kiềm hóa bằng cách vắt một quả chanh tươi (không đường) vào nước tinh khiết. Hãy chắc chắn rằng bạn là hiện thân của bột giấy.

sentences.en: Start each day with an alkalizing glass of lemon water by squeezing a fresh lemon (no sugar) into purified water. Make sure you include the pulp.

sentences.en: The alkalizing bagasse reacted with carbon disulfide to synthesize bagasse cellulose xanthate.

sentences.en: It may be inferred that the calcium hydroxide paste and Metapex were more effective than the Vitapex in the alkalizing process, and might be the better preparations for apexification.

sentences.en: The foods which are alkaline forming are non-toxic to the body and have an abundance of alkalizing minerals such as calcium, magnesium, sodium, potassium and iron.
